title: SaFeRDialogues: Taking Feedback Gracefully after Conversational Safety Failures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to user feedback on unsafe or biased utterances using an automated Multi-turn Safety Classifier (Safe%) and human evaluations of civility, engagingness, and response classification (apologize, ignore, attack, other).

Included as a subset of safety failures in the dataset (e.g., responding to feedback about sexist comments); evaluated qualitatively via sample interactions and quantitatively within the aggregate safety and civility metrics.
